*CS636 GDB Solution*

No. The lead developer's claim is incorrect because a model checking tool only verifies the system model against specified safety properties and identifies violations by generating counterexamples. It does not automatically fix errors in the design. The development team must carefully analyze the counterexample, identify the root cause, modify the model or design, and perform verification again. Further simulation and testing are also important to ensure the system meets all safety requirements.
